other.label: Other Machine-Singleton Environments
other.description: Other heavy or machine-wide shared tools and local services

shared_criteria: Large footprint (> 500 MB) or contains model weights, SDKs, or heavy system binaries
Depends on GPU / CUDA / drivers or runs as a local port service (ComfyUI, STT, TTS, Ollama)
Reusable system-level toolchain shared across projects (Android SDK/NDK, reverse engineering kits, shared runtimes)
Machine-singleton environment that should never be reinstalled inside each project workspace
local_criteria: Disposable temporary experiments or one-off test folders
naming_rule: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (kebab-case), e.g. comfyui, stt-whisper, android-sdk, reverse-frida
